capture_method: curl -L against the public Ashby posting API endpoint with the job-harness-v2 HTTP user-agent
redactions: None. The fixture preserves the complete public Ashby posting API response captured from the source.
notes: The API exposes listed jobs with title, department, team, employment type, workplace type, primary and secondary locations, publishedAt, jobUrl, applyUrl, and descriptionHtml.
Current jobs set shouldDisplayCompensationOnJobBoard and compensationTierSummary to null, so salary criteria remain unsupported for this source.
